newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton steady, profit-taking on monsoon seen.
newsitem.headline: India cotton steady, profit-taking on monsoon seen.

text.p: India's Punjab cotton prices on Tuesday held steady in a narrow price range while Gujarat varieties suffered a setback on the local market, dealers said.
Punjab cotton was steady as mill buying remained slow while inflows eased, one dealer said.
In spot deals, Punjab saw-jinned was steady at 1,825 rupees/1,850 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), as well as the Bengal deshi at 1,025 rupees/1,070 rupees per maund, he said.

Gujarat long staple sankar-four cotton lost gained ground and fell by 200/500 rupees at 19,000 rupees/20,000 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) due to profit-taking by stockists following the progress of monsoon, dealers said..
Gujarat kalyan was steady at 13,900 rupees/14,000 rupees per candy. Wagad cotton also remained steady at 12,700 rupees/12,800 rupees per candy, dealers said.
